entities.summary: Egor Sokolov is a Russian professional ice hockey left winger for Torpedo Nizhny Novgorod of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Ottawa Senators in the second round, 61st overall, of the 2020 NHL entry draft.
